reason: Head office has to approve any customer-facing system change, and Sora has no restaurant live yet, so I would be the guinea pig with no proof it works in a busy service. I would also still be ringing everything up on the POS, so my staff do double work for now.
objection: Customers ordering from their phones and walking out is what I already fear, and a brand-new company with no live references is asking me to trust them with my tables and my head office relationship.
would_change_my_mind: A head office sign-off plus a live restaurant of similar size that has run it for a few months and confirms the pay-now setting stopped walk-outs.
